testCase.name: [本地] S23 Browser clock a day off: a task closed by Save & Extract is stamped with server time and stays in Finished Tasks

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B18 · P1 · 已知

很多时间和日期按设备时钟算，没有用服务器时间（违反 UAT 3.8）：「NEW TODAY」、入院日期、体征日期、任务完成时间、转录日期都跟着手机走；手机慢两天时停药被打成两天前，下次清理就把这个药删了

票：TFA-92584 ready for qa（UAT 3.8） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：根因已知（Daniela 10-03 提过要用服务器时间）；删药、掉标签、草稿恢复错这几个症状是新的

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S23 「浏览器时钟差一天：Save & Extract 关掉的任务按服务器时间打时间戳，并留在 Finished Tasks 里」 Browser clock a day off: a task closed by Save & Extract is stamped with server time and stays in Finished Tasks

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U13 Task retention and clock: Hospital completed tasks clear at 16 h; Hospital open tasks clear 36 h after the chart was last processed; …（UAT 3.6；UAT 3.8）
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both（UAT TC-22 step 4；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident with 'follow up BMP' and 'recheck weight in two weeks'; Playwright context with page.clock.setSystemTime(server now + 24 h), and a second run with server now − 24 h; …

When Tap Save & Extract; read the task's doneAt through a read-only backend query (rounding:list / snf:list); reload the list so applyLifecycle runs; open Task Export and expand Finished Tasks

Then doneAt within ±5 min of server time in both runs; after the lifecycle run 'follow up BMP' is still under Finished Tasks

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8: every time-based rule uses the server clock. Predicted Fail on main: useEncounterTasks.ts and useSaveAndExtract.ts stamp doneAt with new Date(), so the −24 h run is cleared at once by the server-time 16 h rule and the +24 h run would keep it about 40 h. The Task Export row shows no closed time, so the stored value decides. The same rule on the tap path is TC-07 S28; …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92592 ready for pr；TFA-92585 ready for pr

手机时钟慢一天时，Save & Extract 关掉的任务按手机时间盖戳，列表一刷新就从 Finished Tasks 消失；快一天时会多留约 40 小时，而不是 16 小时。

On a phone whose clock is a day behind, a task closed by Save & Extract is stamped with the phone's time and disappears from Finished Tasks as soon as the list reloads; a day ahead, it lingers about 40 h instead of 16 h.

依据：allure-results/2ecd961c…: all 4 runs put doneAt at device time ±1440 min. With the Hospital clock 24 h behind, the closed task drops out of Finished Tasks after the list reloads. The NH half is already recorded (docs/2026-10-13-pr106-review.md S3) and fixed on PR #106 head 35edc8b (clockNow), not merged. The Hospital stamp (useEncounterTasks.ts new Date()) is unchanged on #106 and appears nowhere else (dev report, ledger, knownGaps); a matrix risk predicted it.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-22/S23

Browser clock a day off: a task closed by Save & Extract is stamped with server time and stays in Finished Tasks

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for pr)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New Playwright spec, two runs (browser clock server now + 24 h and - 24 h), each in both contexts: fresh account, Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident with 'follow up BMP' and 'recheck weight in two weeks'; ai/parsing:extractTasks answered at the socket to close 'follow up BMP'. Save & Extract; read the task's doneAt (rounding:list / snf:list) against time:now (+-5 min); reload the list so applyLifecycle runs; open Task Export, expand Finished Tasks and look for 'follow up BMP'. Nursing Home: 'still under Finished Tasks' is recorded only (TC-22 Q12, no retention stated for completed Nursing Home tasks); doneAt is judged in both contexts. — Clock, socket answer and the account's own reads are all scriptable.

Detail:

Re-run 16:51 JST after review; all 4 runs fail on doneAt (as in 2-3 earlier runs each). Clock -24 h: doneAt = device time, 1440 min before server (Hospital 2026-10-13T07:51 vs server 2026-10-14T07:51; Nursing Home likewise). Clock +24 h: doneAt 1440 min after server. Retention after the list reload: Hospital -24 h - 'follow up BMP' is removed and not under Finished Tasks (judged, U13: Hospital completed tasks 16 h); Hospital +24 h kept. Nursing Home -24 h removed too, but that is recorded only: UAT 3.6 gives no retention for completed Nursing Home tasks (TC-22 Q12).

产品问题：On a device whose clock is a day off, a task closed by Save & Extract ('BMP came back…' closes 'follow up BMP') gets the device's time as doneAt, in Hospital and Nursing Home (useEncounterTasks.ts:145 and snf useSaveAndExtract.ts:62 stamp, used at :70, use new Date()): breaks UAT 3.8 in both contexts. Hospital: a day behind, the task vanishes from Task Export > Finished Tasks as soon as the list reloads; a day ahead, it would stay about 40 h instead of 16 h (UAT 3.6, U13). Nursing Home shows the same removal, but how long a completed Nursing Home task should stay is open (TC-22 Q12).

证据：附了 5 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): page.clock in the browser and ai/parsing:extractTasks mocked with trackActionRequests on a fresh local account, so the stamp, not the model, is under test; dev has no admin key, one shared account and no action mock, so it runs on the local stack only …. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
